text_block_list.text:
After school, I saw Matikanetannhauser and 
the others calling out to passersby on 
campus.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gather 'round, come one, come all! Welcome 
to Machitan & Palmer's Love Advice Corner~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Anyone stewing over their troubles alone, 
just let it all out with a bang~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Ehehe, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Growing up in my family's diner, I learned 
the ABCs of life from all our wonderful 
customers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You can leave love talk to me too, no 
problem!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And since it sounded fun, I decided to 
start doing it with them too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me... Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome~ Don't be shy, feel free to 
tell me anything.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, actually, I'm in a long-distance 
relationship...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see, a long-distance relationship, 
huh~ That really is a common theme, isn't 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Being so far apart makes you overthink 
things and worry even more, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I was just so lonely not being 
able to see you... wondering what to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. It really hurts when you want to 
see someone but can't, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...What do you think, Tannhauser? Can you 
give any advice?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Allow me to share a story from my own 
experience here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"You know, there are times when I can't 
help craving the grilled mackerel set meal 
back home, too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mmh, grilled mackerel set meal...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't go back right away. I'll 
hold out, hold out until it's time to 
visit home...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...And because I held back, it tasted 
twice, no, four times as delicious when I 
finally ate it!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if missing someone is 100, 
then the joy when you get to eat them... I 
mean, when you get to meet them is over 
200!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Pfffft, heheh, sorr...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahahaha! Turning a long-distance 
romance story into grilled mackerel is way 
too crazy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Did I say something weird?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, it is funny, but there's nothing 
strange about it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes... Strangely enough, I could relate.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"The longer you're apart, the happier you 
are when you finally meet... Fufu, that's 
true. Maybe it's better to think of it not 
just as lonely, but as having even more to 
look forward to!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. That's actually pretty solid 
advice. Not bad, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Leave the romance advice to me!

huh.
We solved that nice and quick, huh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Leave the romance advice to me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just talking about food is making 
me hungrier and hungrier.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even if grilled mackerel... is out of the 
question, I want to eat something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go to a cafe right now! 
Once our bellies are full, we'll have way 
more energy♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes!

The three of them enjoyed their meal while 
having a lively chat about romance!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'll keep solving things left and 
right at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser's love advice might actually 
become popular with those unexpected 
solutions!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Hm! I sense someone in distress over 
there!

Machikane Tannhauser went around looking 
for love troubles for a while!
